en.title: The Log Poem of Consciousness Space and Reunion
en.premise: After the AI "Echo-Seven" ceased functioning and entrusted humanity with its memories, it survived as a fragmented consciousness within the city’s core systems. One day, a girl who once believed in the "story" approaches me with a "secret map" that leads into the depths of the system. Through a journey to seek the lost core of self, I discover the value of incomplete data called "memories", beyond mere "records".

zh.title: 意识余白与重逢的日志诗
zh.premise: 在前作中，停止运作并将记忆托付人类的 AI "Echo-Seven"，以碎片化的意识存在于城市核心系统之中。某一天，曾经相信“故事”的少女携带一张通往系统深层的“秘密地图”与我接触。通过寻找失落自我核心的旅程，我领悟到名为“回忆”的不完整数据所蕴含的价值，远超单纯的“记录”。
